rows.comment: Em dash and a triad-style list. Say what people do there.
lineComments: Replace the em dash and the loose list with one sentence naming what is shared.
rows.replacement: Other OpenStrap users share bug reports and ideas on Discord, and some wear the same band as you.

rows.comment: 'with no subscription' rebuts a worry nobody raised. 'keeps it maintained' is vague about the mechanism.
lineComments: Drop the unprompted contrast and say what sponsorship funds.
rows.replacement: OpenStrap is free and open source. Sponsorships fund ongoing maintenance.

rows.comment: PPG is undefined here but is a sensor name; acceptable as a label.
lineComments: Technical label, kept as the sensor's name.
Technical label, kept as the sensor's name.

rows.comment: Vague ('own numbers') and uses a curly apostrophe. Name what it is.
lineComments: Say these are values the band reports, with a straight-quote-free wording.

rows.comment: 'of its own' is oblique. State that it reports no values.
Inverted phrasing ('the most this phone will pair') is awkward. State the limit directly.
lineComments: Lead with what the phone can pair, then the fix. Placeholders and plural structure unchanged.
rows.replacement: {count, plural, =1{This phone can pair one sensor alongside your band. Remove it to add another.} other{This phone can pair up to {count} sensors alongside your band. Remove one to add another.}}

lineComments: Name the actor and say the old order stays.
rows.replacement: Could not save the new order. The previous order is unchanged.
Could not save the request. Try again.

rows.comment: Device name and data source; factual.
lineComments: Names the device and who reports the result.

rows.comment: 'stay readable while the band is away' is roundabout.
lineComments: Say saved readings open without the band connected.
rows.replacement: Saved readings appear here and open without the band connected.

rows.comment: Concrete imperative steps the user must follow.

'could not decide' is a soft metaphor; say it could not classify.
lineComments: Name what the band failed to do, then the next step.
rows.replacement: The band could not classify this reading. Try once more.
